title: Private Universities and Educational Institutes Laws Amendment Act 2004

sections.shortTitle: Private Universities and Educational Institutes Laws Amendment Act 2004
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VI OF 2005
ACT VI OF 2005
PRIVATE UNIVERSITIES
AND EDUCATIONAL
INSTITUTES LAWS
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2004
An Act to amend certain
laws relating to the Private
Universities and
Educational Institutes in force
in the Province
of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV,
12th November, 2005]
No.PAS/LEGIS-B-5/2004, dated
12-11-2005.---The Private Universities and Educational Institutes Laws
(Amendment) Bill, 2004 has been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 13th May, 2005 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 18th October, 2005, is hereby published as an Act
of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to amend certain laws
relating to the Private Universities and Educational Institutes in force in the
Province of Sindh, in the manner hereinafter
appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Private Universities
and Educational Institutes Laws (Amendment) Act, 2004.
(2)
It shall come into force at once.
